reason: The free first visit is the only reason I'd go. I like the cleaning log and the cap on how many kids are in at once, but money is tight after daycare went up. I'd try it once and probably not come back often.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up. $13 a kid plus gas plus whatever the cafe costs is a lot when I already pay for daycare. I also don't know yet if it's actually clean in person.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper way to go regularly, like a lower per-visit price or a pack under $10 a visit, would get me back more than once. Seeing the cleaning log and the space in person would help too.
